def solve_batch(study: dict) -> dict:
    train = study['train']
    (g, fd, cd) = _features(study, np.vstack((train['x'], study['test']['x'])))
    traj = train['traj']
    basis = np.linalg.svd(traj, full_matrices=False)[2][:2]
    target = np.column_stack((train['y'], traj @ basis.T))
    base = _ridge(g, target, 0.0003)
    prediction = 0.5 * base + (_ridge(np.column_stack((g, fd)), target, 0.003) + _ridge(np.column_stack((g, cd)), target, 0.0003) + _ridge(np.column_stack((g, fd, cd)), target, 0.001)) / 6
    y_hat = prediction[:, 0]
    state_pred = prediction[:, 1:] @ basis
    terminal = state_pred[:, -1]
    return {'y_hat': y_hat, 'state_pred': state_pred, 'diagnostics_vec': np.array([y_hat.mean(), y_hat.std(), terminal.mean(), terminal.std()])}
